featured_reviews.name: Harshal Chothe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Unethical and Harassing Behavior by Aditya Birla Capital Recovery Agents

I am writing this review to raise a serious concern about the highly unprofessional and unethical behavior I have experienced from Aditya Birla Capital Limited.

My sister had taken a personal loan from the company, which she unfortunately defaulted on. However, I am not a guarantor or co-applicant on this loan. Despite this, an agent named Neha Singh from Aditya Birla Capital has been repeatedly calling me and even went to the extent of calling my office landline after searching for my employment details.

These repeated calls have caused immense disturbance at my workplace, seriously damaging my reputation and image in front of my seniors and colleagues. The language used by the agent was not only abusive and threatening, but the tone was clearly intimidating and harassing. This is completely unacceptable, especially since I have no legal or financial obligation related to the loan.

Even after clearly denying any involvement and asking them to stop contacting me, the calls continued, showing a blatant disregard for ethical recovery practices and basic human decency.

Such tactics not only reflect poorly on the company’s professionalism but also amount to mental harassment and invasion of privacy. I strongly advise others to think twice before taking any loan from Aditya Birla Capital, as this kind of behavior can lead to serious emotional distress and workplace embarrassment, even if you're not directly involved.

My recommendation: Avoid taking any loans from Aditya Birla Capital.
